sourceBaseline.scoreScope: Comparative initial impressions from original front and16 frame-zero crops; not candidate grades, not a numeric pass threshold.
observations: Ama is recognizable in front: dark-brown face, short scalloped dark fringe, golden-yellow headwrap, ivory coat, green bib/apron and tie, small dark shoe ends. These identities are already clear and should survive refinement.

The original headwrap has a pointed angular crown and near-flat very bright yellow upper faces; its horizontal folds read as parallel extruded bars. The target gives the cloth more believable broad folds and a softly rolled band.

The source apron is mainly stacked flat rectangular masses with a tiny rectangular pocket mark; sleeves and torso show harsh faceted transitions. At logical size the lower garment details merge into a green block.

Original E/W profiles show a very thin front headwrap edge, compact nose/face edge, rounded hair mass at back and a slab-like sleeve/torso transition. Side and rear design quality needs an independent bar because the target supplies only a front view.

The source yellow highlights approach flat pale neon yellow while skin and green apron shade down strongly. The target offers warmer graded golden fabric, cream coat and green volume separation but its lighter orange skin conflicts with the identity lock.
Source footwear is a small dark horizontal toe indication; it should remain grounded/readable without adding incompatible height or changing action feet.

The target apron straps, pocket edge, collar/cuffs and tied waist are useful purposeful construction cues. Exact stitching, button count, hair lobe count, source part count and decorative arrangement are not required.
Intentional dark pupils, hair, shoe soles, and contact creases are legitimate. Unexplained near-black patches, merged surfaces and invisible shape changes would be defects.

adopt: Readable folded headwrap with softly rounded cloth boundaries
Green apron/tie with readable functional detail and coherent silhouette
doNotCopy: Target canvas filling/framing or apparent different camera/scale
Colored alpha fringe/halo and detached bright specks
Unseen rear/profile forms invented as reference facts
Family concept white toque, blue apron or red necktie
Photo-texture or exact microstitching that disappears at intended size
targetInterpretation.modelingFreedom: Native proportions, forms, structure and purposeful decorations may improve; source weak geometry/part counts are not constraints. Aesthetic departures are judged by outcome and locked identity/function.

rankedDesiredOutcomes.outcome: A golden folded cloth headwrap and friendly short-fringe head that have soft, deliberate volume and coherent front/profile/rear construction, with Ama still dark-brown.
An ivory chef coat and green apron/tie that read as connected crafted garments with meaningful visible collar/cuff/apron/pocket/waist hierarchy at logical use size.
Warm broad light, controlled highlights and clean separations through all states/facings, with grounded feet and continuous hand/knife/dish/load action contacts.
